## Sensitivity and Robustness

Repeat analysis under:

## Falsification

Treat the approach as unsupported if it fails to outperform persistence in rolling-origin log loss, produces materially miscalibrated probabilities, violates simplex constraints, shows leakage-sensitive performance collapse, or cannot reproduce category totals within documented rounding tolerance.
